content: {"like":["Subtle supernatural elements in horror films are preferred over over-the-top effects","Adorable, light-hearted murder mysteries with star pairings are highly enjoyable","Classic period dramas with strong casting and faithful adaptations are appreciated","Animated family films that are fun and visually appealing are favorites","High-quality visual storytelling in fantasy adventures is valued"],"dislike":["Telekinesis or supernatural powers that become too dramatic toward the climax are disliked","Violent or graphic content that overshadows plot in action or thriller movies is off-putting","Flat, characterless storytelling in period dramas feels boring and unengaging","Excessive scientific exposition in historical documentaries detracts from the narrative","Overly stylized or shallow portrayals of religious or mythological figures are not liked"]}
